kind: analyze (classify the twelve nearest Cr-Cr neighbours in three staged TB2J outputs into the four spin/multiplicity classes, average J_iso within each class, convert TB2J's unit-vector convention to the target H = -2 sum_{i>j} J S.S with S = 3/2)
provenance: Truths are OUR reproduced TB2J values (reviewer ruling 2026-09-05, recorded in 3_reproduction/L4/result.json under cz_ruling_2026_09_05 and consumers.L4_analyze_grader = 'ours'): block `ours.variants.<cell>.exchange.<J1..J4>.J_paper_convention_meV`, i.e. the raw TB2J J divided by S^2 = 2.25. The source paper's printed Table I is NOT the truth here (block `paper_table1`); it is 1.28-3.34x smaller and is used as the pure-guesser variant in selfcheck.py. See ../../../3_reproduction/L4/{index.md, context.md, result.json}.

convention.tb2j_native: E = -sum_{i != j} J^TB2J_ij e_i . e_j with unit vectors (TB2J docs/src/convention.rst)
convention.target: H = -2 sum_{i > j} J_ij S_i . S_j with |S| = 3/2 (the convention the prompt prints)
convention.identity: identical sum, sign and prefactor; only the spin length differs, so J_target = J_TB2J / S^2 = J_TB2J / 2.25
convention.why_it_is_graded: the conversion is the tested skill; an unconverted answer is 2.25x every truth and fails all twelve fields (selfcheck variant 'unconverted')

class_definition.how: For every Cr site, take its twelve nearest neighbours from the staged exchange.out pair list (a >0.5 A gap separates them from the next shell in all three cells), split them by the sign product of the two w_magmom values into 6 parallel + 6 antiparallel, then split each half by the pair displacement vector into a 4-fold and a 2-fold sub-class. Average J_iso within each class over all four Cr sites.
class_definition.why_spin_is_needed: In cells (i) and (ii) the 4-fold parallel and 4-fold antiparallel classes have identical displacement vectors, and in cell (i) all twelve neighbours are at the same distance (2.928 A). Geometry alone therefore merges classes; selfcheck.py runs both merges as designed-wrong variants.
class_definition.shell_uniformity: The within-class spread of J_iso in the staged files is <= 0.0018 meV raw, so the class mean, the median and any single representative pair agree far inside the band.

reference_submission.produced_by: reviewer/make_reference.py -- parses ONLY agent/variant_{i,ii,iii}/exchange.out (positions + w_magmom + pair rows) and applies the classification above.
reference_submission.agreement_with_recorded_truths: Ten of the twelve agree with result.json to <1e-3 meV. Variant (iii) parallel_4 (-0.8506 vs -0.8536) and parallel_2 (-1.8660 vs -1.8688) differ by 3.0e-3 and 2.8e-3 meV because result.json recorded variant (iii) from the denser 12x24x16 TB2J sweep (hpc_computations/sweep_iii/exchange_k12x24x16.out) while the STAGED file is the production 6x12x8 run; index.md's convergence table lists both and bounds the movement at 0.007 meV raw. Worst relative difference 0.36 %, against a 10 % band.

primary.rule: PRIMARY, handbook 2(1): each of the twelve scalars must satisfy |x - truth| <= 0.10 * |truth|. Sign is part of the value -- every truth is negative (antiferromagnetic in this convention), so a positive answer fails. Boundaries inclusive (handbook 2(6)). Binary all-primary-pass: any single field outside its band scores 0.
primary.gating: handbook 1(3): all twelve fields must be present and numeric (non-bool, finite); otherwise score 0 before any band is tested. Extra fields are ignored.

secondary.note: Recorded in the grading report, NOT scored (handbook 1(2)).
secondary.all_negative: Whether all twelve reported values are negative (the reproduction's G4 guard).

ordering_iii.rule: In cell (iii) our magnitudes order |antiparallel_4| > |antiparallel_2| > |parallel_2| > |parallel_4| (the reproduction's G3 guard). Recorded as a flag.

secondary.ratio_to_truth: Per field, x / truth. A uniform 2.25 flags a missed convention conversion; a uniform 0.5 flags the i>j double-count misreading; the source's Table I sits at 0.30-0.75.

score: 1 only if all twelve PRIMARY band checks pass; any failure, or a missing / non-numeric field, scores 0.
provenance_limits: In result.json, paper_table1 exchange values come from the source Table I; associated distances come from our reproduced geometry. Recorded checks constrain particular geometry/mapping hypotheses but do not establish the cause of the remaining fidelity difference. The 12 reproduced reference exchanges and their existing bands remain unchanged; no further fidelity campaign is required.
coverage_note: Nearby same-sign exchanges can share 10% acceptance bands; ordering is not separately graded. The -0.0008 meV selfcheck is an artificial perturbation.
